name: My Dad Died at the Silk-Spun Heath
source:
I grew up in silence, with only my mother for company. Work filled my days, questions filled my nights. Father’s absence was never spoken of – until I dared to ask. That was the day everything changed.

[From [url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/my-dad-died-at-the-silk-spun-heath]Itch.io[/url]]
